test_title: PYST 20: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 08 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

She makes sure that all __the newly realised books__ are available in her personal library
solution: The correct answer is: **the newly released books**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word "**realised**" in the original sentence means "made real or actual." (वास्तविक बनाया गया) • The word "**released**" means "made available to the public." (जनता के लिए उपलब्ध कराया गया) • The context of the sentence suggests that the books are being made available for people to borrow or read. Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**. **Corrected sentence**: *She makes sure that all the newly released books__ are available in her personal library.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Regaled **is a verb that means "entertained or amused with talk or stories." (बातचीत या कहानियों से मनोरंजन या आनंदित करना) • **Relieved **is a verb that means "made someone feel happy or satisfied again." (किसी को फिर से खुश या संतुष्ट महसूस कराया) • **Reverberated **is a verb that means "be repeated several times as an echo." (एक प्रतिध्वनि के रूप में कई बार दोहराया जाना चाहिए) 37:T74e, The correct answer is: **ABCDE**
